name: LeadCatch
description: Production-ready lead tracking, quote builder, and follow-up assistant for independent home-service businesses (cleaning, painting, plumbing, garden maintenance, handymen).
author: LeadCatch Engineering Team
targetAudience: Independent contractors, home service operators, cleaning businesses, painters, plumbers, electricians, landscapers
budget: $0 (Zero recurring costs, zero mandatory external APIs, zero paid database requirements)

stack.storage: Browser localStorage (with JSON export/import & schema validation)

features.name: Live Revenue & Pipeline Dashboard
features.description: Displays total leads, new leads, active pipeline value, realized won revenue, quotes awaiting response, and prioritized upcoming follow-up queue.

features.name: Full Lead CRM with Validation
features.description: Create, edit, search, filter, and delete leads with required field checks, unboxed metadata, and destructive confirmation modals.

features.name: Itemized Service Quote Builder & PDF Print Engine
features.description: Build multi-line service proposals with dynamic item addition, unit pricing, automatic subtotals, customizable taxes/discounts, and browser print-to-PDF formatting.

features.name: Home-Service Follow-Up Outreach Engine
features.description: 5 targeted home-service follow-up templates (First response, friendly reminder, quote check-in, final loop, booking welcome) with live merge-tags, copy-to-clipboard, WhatsApp (wa.me) launcher, and email client integration.

features.name: Conversion Analytics & Channel Reports
features.description: Tracks win rate of closed opportunities, conversion ratios, service performance, lead acquisition channels, and overdue follow-up velocity with division-by-zero protection.

features.name: Client-Side Persistence & Portability
features.description: Safely stores data in browser localStorage with schema sanitization, JSON export/download, validated JSON import (merge/replace), and one-click demo data restoration.

deployment.platform: Vercel / GitHub Pages / Any Static Host
